summary: Tested Iteration 18 features: (1) Admin Pagamenti 'Incassi per giornata e campo' section with day cards, expand/collapse toggle, CSV exports (all + per-day), and role guard hiding it from club managers. (2) Backend role guard on GET /api/tournaments/{tid}/payments/daily (403 for club_manager, 200 for admin) and CSV export endpoint. (3) Callup notification flow: adding a player to a match creates a 'Luca è convocato:' notification for the parent (fan), visible in the fan notifications panel on /account with the shirt icon. (4) Reminder + dedupe: after moving kickoff to +3h an 'Oggi in campo: Luca' notification appears and does NOT duplicate on re-poll. All backend seed data restored (kickoff reverted, callups cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: DailyTakings.jsx uses `defaultOpen` prop but stores it only as the initial state; changing the array order (e.g. after tid change) would not re-open the new first card because useEffect isn't reset in DayCard. Not a functional bug now but worth noting.

downloadCsv() calls URL.revokeObjectURL immediately after a.click(); the click on <a> is synchronous and download is queued, but Chrome sometimes needs the URL a tick longer. Consider using setTimeout(revoke, 0) if downloads flake on slower networks (worked fine in tests).
